newsitem.title: NORWAY: PGS buying seismic ships it now charters.
newsitem.headline: PGS buying seismic ships it now charters.

text.p: Norwegian offshore company Petroleum Geo-Services ASA (PGS) said on Monday it had recently finalised its acquisition of seismic ships R/V American Explorer, R/V Ocean Explorer and M/V Nordic Explorer.
In addition, the company said in a statement it had agreed to buy the M/V Atlantic Explorer. This purchase is expected to be finalised by the end of February.

PGS did not say which company sold the ships, nor how much it paid for the vessels, which were built between 1979 and 1987. The three first vessels have been chartered by PGS since 1993 while the Atlantic Explorer has been chartered by the company since 1994.
"These vessels will remain technologically competitive and will continue to meet our high operating standards," PGS Chief Operating Officer Bjarte Bruheim said in the statement.
